marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Taking a clever reality-TV approach, this video focuses on the USDA MyPlate Dietary Guidelines and the best ways for teens to work them into day-to-day life. A high school student named Lexi accepts a challenge from a professional dietician to eat more balanced meals and get more physical exercise over a period of 4 weeks, with the ultimate goal of satisfying-and sticking with!-the MyPlate system. At the start of Week One, Lexi's "food IQ" is less than ideal, as reflected in her menu choices and portion sizes as well as her sedentary TV and computer habits. But by Week Four, she has successfully combined healthy eating and healthy activities into a formula for fitness-and a promising future!
